subject: Interim telemetry processor (temporary bridge) - notification & egress clarifications
messages:
From: Anna Peters <anna.peters@edgebridge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: security@edgebridge.io
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interim telemetry relay - EdgeBridge (temporary)

Hi Marissa,

Heads up — Fintegrate has asked us to stand up a short-lived telemetry relay while they finish a carrier migration. We will act as a temporary processing agent for telemetry and operational logs (not full PII payloads) between Aug 18 and Aug 25.

Key points:
- Scope: routing of anonymized telemetry + application metrics (no customer content payloads).
- Residency / egress: primary egress from our EU cluster (Frankfurt); fallbacks in Ireland and UK. See attached egress_map.png for country hops.
- Retention: transient buffering only (max 7 days). We do not persist indexable identifiers; we store only hashed ids.
- Security: TLS-in-transit + at-rest encryption using our KMS tenant. SOC2 summary attached.
- Contact: Anna Peters (security lead)

Attached: edgebridge_temp_roster.csv, egress_map.png, soc2_summary.pdf

We wanted to notify Redwood and confirm there are no objectionable data paths before cutover. Please let us know any DPA addendum items you need (we can support a narrow addendum for this window).

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Peters
Head of Security, EdgeBridge
anna.peters@edgebridge.io
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Anna Peters <anna.peters@edgebridge.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim telemetry relay - EdgeBridge (temporary)

Thanks for the notice and the attachments, Anna — sending a few quick clarifying questions so our compliance and infra teams can sign off before Aug 18 cutover: 

1) Exact data fields: can you confirm the telemetry schema and specifically call out any device or user_ids that might be present (even hashed)? We need a column-level map for our DPA team.
2) KMS details: which KMS provider/tenant is used for the temp buffer? Any shared crypto keys with third parties?
3) Onshore fallback: do you support an onshore relay (EU-only) if we need to block cross-border hops mid-window? If yes, how quickly can it be flipped?
4) Evidence: please add a short CSV mapping (processor, country, egress_ip_ranges) and a link to your SOC2 cert (PDF is fine).

Cc'ing Kimberly (privacy) and Laura (infra) — Kimberly, could you weigh in on whether a 7-day transient buffer + hashed ids is acceptable for Fintegrate's contract? Laura, can infra validate the egress_map ranges against our firewall rules?

If we get answers by EOD today, we can proceed with a limited addendum. Otherwise we'll need to delay the cutover.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Privacy & Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Anna Peters <anna.peters@edgebridge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: security@edgebridge.io
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim telemetry relay - EdgeBridge (temporary)

Marissa — thanks, questions below inline and I've attached the CSV map you asked for (edgebridge_temp_roster.csv). Also added a short checklist PDF to the shared drive.

1) Data fields: schema attached (see roster CSV column "fields_summary"). Confirmed: device_id (hashed SHA256), session_start, error_code, metric_values. No customer message bodies.
2) KMS: we use AWS KMS (account id 111122223333) in a tenant isolated to EdgeBridge. Keys are not shared with third parties; access is limited to EdgeBridge KMS operators.
3) Onshore fallback: we can flip to an EU-only routing group (Frankfurt primary) within ~2 hours. We will pre-stage the route and provide a rollback playbook.
4) Evidence: SOC2 report attached (soc2_summary.pdf). Egress IP ranges included in CSV and flagged by country column. Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/edgebridge/temp-roster

We are ready to proceed on Aug 18 02:00 UTC if you confirm. If Redwood needs a signed addendum we can prepare a 1-page DPA addendum (temporary processor) and sign via DocuSign.

Regards,
Anna

Attachments referenced: edgebridge_temp_roster.csv, egress_map.png, soc2_summary.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Anna Peters <anna.peters@edgebridge.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim telemetry relay - EdgeBridge (temporary)

Thanks Anna — reviewed with privacy and infra. Summary and next steps: 

- Privacy: hashed device_id + 7-day transient buffer is acceptable for Fintegrate under a narrow addendum. We will require the 1-page DPA addendum that limits scope to telemetry only and specifies the EU-only fallback and max retention.
- Security: Laura confirmed IP ranges; infra will add allowed egress CIDR to our firewall rules this afternoon.
- Action items:
  1) Anna: please upload the DocuSign-ready 1-page addendum to the Drive link (Label: FB-EdgeBridge-Addendum).
  2) Marissa: once DocuSign link is in place, please execute and file in the DPA tracker (HubSpot: HS-43922).
  3) Laura: stand by to cut traffic at 02:00 UTC on Aug 18 and to execute rollback to EU-only if needed.

If those items are in place by 23:00 UTC today, we will greenlight the temporary relay.

Kimberly Park
Director, Privacy Compliance
Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com
